comments.note: Constraint 0 scope carve-out is architecturally precise: 'This constraint applies to workflow logic only — file I/O, schema validation, concurrency primitives, and other infrastructure concerns are governed by their respective constraints below.' This prevents the spec-first rule from being misread as applying to Constraints 1–10 (file system, STDIO, schema) which have no spec counterpart. Without this carve-out, an agent might incorrectly infer that adding atomic I/O behavior requires a spec amendment first.

Footnote placement pattern (end-of-constraint, blockquote format) is consistent across all four cross-referenced constraints (11, 13, 19, 22). The links use relative paths and deeply-linked anchors (e.g., '#62-transition-table', '#65-agent-guards') which will survive file renames within the workflow-specification directory. Good.
